text.en: This Order may be cited as the Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) (Amendment) Order, 2015 and shall commence on the same date as the Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Order, 20 1 1. Amendment of First Schedule of S 641201 1

The First Schedule to the Consumer Protection (Fair Trading] Order, 2011, is

(a) in paragraph 1 -

(i) by deleting "1" before "The" from the first line; and

(ii) in subparagraph (c), by deleting "specified in paragraph 2".

(b) by deleting paragraph 2. Made this 26th. day of Zulhijjah, 1436 Hijriah corresponding to the 10th. day of October, 2015 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh AWANG HAJI KAMARUL AZAM BIN HAJI MOHAMAD Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalani.
